name: Minami-Asagaya
tagline: Shinjuku in 14 minutes and Shibuya in 24 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Suginami City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 14 minutes to Shinjuku, 24 minutes to Shibuya and 45 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 44.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.6 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 44.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 39.7 m to 45.3 m, a difference of 5.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 26 clinics and 21 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 河北総合病院, about 13 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is マキ皮膚科, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 14 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
